claims_in_paper.claim_text: The UK Strategic Road Network carries approximately one-third of all road traffic and two-thirds of freight tonne-kilometres , yet its adaptive capacity to changing climate conditions is under strain.

This directly addresses the evidence gap identified by the UK Department for Transport's Rapid Evidence Assessment, which highlights the need for better understanding of climate change impacts on transport infrastructure .
Transport climate resilience research spans qualitative risk reviews and quantitative resilience methodologies , as well as simulation-based approaches.
